aggregate.note: SemIfHead numbers — SemIf (community System One reproduction, Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B pinned, mlx backend) scores ALL questions for a step in ONE shared-state pass (one state prefill + one batched suffix forward); agreement measures how often its declared-option argmax choices match the recorded LLM decisions. Per-option probabilities are SemIf's conditional option scores (uncalibrated per its own docs); confidence is the same entropy-based convention as the mlx direct-logit head. Target menus truncate at 16 options (SemIf's hard A–P letter cap).
